key_features: 110,000 RPM HIGH-SPEED CLEANING POWER: Driven by a high-efficiency motor reaching up to 110,000 RPM at the highest setting, this electric air duster delivers concentrated airflow to remove dust, crumbs, and fine particles from keyboards, PC cases, radiator fans, and other hard-to-reach areas without physical contact.

3 SPEED CONTROL FOR PRECISE TASKS: Three selectable speed levels adapt to different cleaning needs: 25,000 RPM for delicate electronics, 60,000 RPM for routine dust removal, and 110,000 RPM for stubborn debris. One tool covers light maintenance to deep cleaning across multiple devices and surfaces.

EXTENDED RUNTIME RECHARGEABLE DESIGN: Built with a high-capacity rechargeable battery, the MF70 supports extended use across multiple cleaning sessions on a single charge. At the 1st gear, it blows for up to 300 minutes on a full charge. Cordless operation allows unrestricted movement around desks, vehicles, and workspaces without the limits of power cables.

LIGHTWEIGHT AND PORTABLE FORM FACTOR: Weighing approximately 0.5 lb, this compact air blower is easy to hold and control during use. Its portable size fits easily into backpacks, toolkits, or car storage, making it suitable for home, office, travel, and on-site equipment maintenance.

REUSABLE ALTERNATIVE WITH 5 NOZZLES: Designed as a reusable alternative to disposable compressed air cans, this air duster includes 5 interchangeable nozzles for keyboards, computer interiors, car vents, camera equipment, and general cleaning tasks, supporting long-term, cost-conscious use.
